latest_release.name: AnythingLLM v1.19.0
latest_release.body:
### Built-in LLM for Docker AnythingLLM Docker now has a default local LLM experience right out of the box. The same kind of built-in engine that ships with [AnythingLLM Desktop](https://docs.anythingllm.com/setup/llm-configuration/local/built-in) can now run **inside the container**: [Lemonade](https://lemonade-server.ai), the fully [open-source](https://github.com/lemonade-sdk/lemonade) local inference server from AMD, running your models with [llama.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp). You no longer need to run Ollama, LM Studio or any other inference server next to AnythingLLM. Pass your GPU into the container and the engine is accelerated on whatever hardware you have. It picks the fastest backend automatically: CUDA for NVIDIA GPUs, Vulkan for AMD and Intel GPUs, or the CPU. It runs on both `amd64` and `arm64` hosts. When it's turned on, **Built-in** becomes the default LLM provider during onboarding, with three models recommended for your hardware. You can download any model from the model table or pull any GGUF model from Hugging Face. It works everywhere a provider can be used: the system LLM, workspace and agent LLMs, the chat window model picker, and [Model Router](https://docs.anythingllm.com/model-router/setup). > [!TIP] > **The built-in LLM is off by default.** Turn it on by starting the container with `-e ENABLE_BUILT_IN_LLM=true`, and add `--gpus all` (or pass in your AMD or Intel GPU devices) for GPU acceleration. See [Built-in LLM for Docker](https://docs.anythingllm.com/installation-docker/built-in-llm) for the full setup for each kind of hardware. ### Color palettes Color palettes are straightforward thematic tinting you can apply to the entire UI. We plan to expand this functionality more so you can more heavily customize the UI and even layout. [Learn more](https://docs.anythingllm.com/features/branding)
---- ## What's Changed * fix: route Bedrock India (in.) inference profiles via bedrock-runtime by @kimnamu in https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6717 * Remove open-computer (moved to its own repo) by @timothycarambat in https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6727 * Neutralize spreadsheet formulas in CSV chat exports by @timothycarambat in https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6728 * Cap request body size to prevent unauthenticated embed DoS by @timothycarambat in https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6729 * feat: show notice when response hits max output token limit (#6703) by @ManojDevarajulu in https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6726 * Hold clarifying-question timeout once the user starts answering by @timothycarambat in https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6730 * Move Weaviate to weaviate-client v3 by @shatfield4 in https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6675 * Support .mov files for transcription by @shatfield4 in https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6721 * Stop system prompt variable values from expanding other placeholders by @shatfield4 in https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6731 * Apply workspace model changes t

Watch the demo! [![Watch the video](/images/youtube.png)](https://youtu.be/f95rGD9trL0)
### Product Overview AnythingLLM is the all-in-one AI application that lets you build a private, fully-featured ChatGPT—without compromises. Connect your favorite local or cloud LLM, ingest your documents, and start chatting in minutes. Out of the box you get built-in agents, multi-user support, vector databases, and document pipelines — no extra configuration required. AnythingLLM supports multiple users as well where you can control the access and experience per user without compromising the security or privacy of the instance or your intel
